tagline.en_US: MineOS is a server front-end to ease managing Minecraft administrative tasks. This iteration using Node.js aims to enhance previous MineOS scripts (Python-based), by leveraging the event-triggering, asyncronous model of Node.JS and websockets.

description.en_US: MineOS is a server management front-end designed to ease Minecraft administrative tasks. It allows administrators to create, start, stop, and configure multiple Minecraft server instances through a web interface. The platform also provides real-time system health, disk and memory monitoring, and direct access to in-game console logs and command execution.

tips: Authentication uses the user accounts and passwords of the underlying Linux system.
